label: Game A
nuance_found: Chain kills for a multiplier (x2 up to x7 seen), hold BLOOM until a crowd or nest is close and pop it for a BLOOMSTORM (score jumped 5.8k to 19k once), fight on painted ground because you heal there and the ink is slow. Real trade-off is when to spend BLOOM, but one fire-and-chase line dominates.
audio: A looping music bed the whole time plus procedural noise bursts for shots and hits, a falling saw tone on damage, and a chime on kills. Punchy enough, but little variety.
furthest_progress: Olive Terraces first inkwell, broke 1 of 3 nodes twice but never finished it; score 88,940, x7 multiplier peak, 1.8% restored, about 7 deaths
control_trouble: Aiming and turning with the right thumb drag was very touchy and my yaw drifted, so I walked away from the objective many times. Some of that is the harness, but the gold marker pinning to a screen edge also misled me.
best_moment: BLOOMSTORM at x6: the whole grey hillside burst into colour and the score jumped by over 13k.
worst_moment: Dying at the inkwell to stalkers I could not see or target, then walking 40 to 60 s back from the lantern. The respawn walk is dead time.
verdict: The score system is great: multiplier chains, bloomstorm bursts, colour flooding back and numbers flying. I got it in about 25 s and wanted to chain it. But a lot of my time was a long slow walk across a big grey map, and the inkwell fight kills you from things the auto-aim ignores while it locks the well. Nothing ever told me what was hurting me. When I was in a pack of blobs with BLOOM ready it was a 7, the rest was a 4. I would try it once more, not tell friends.
